title: Codex ignores a project's .codex config until the project is trusted
body: Expect DD's hooks to be absent until the user trusts the project in an interactive Codex session and trusts the hooks in /hooks; project skills in .agents/skills still load without trust. Do not try to force trust from the agent: a -c projects.'<path>'.trust_level="trusted" override did not make `codex exec` load the project layer. Ask the user to open the project in codex once, accept trust, approve the hooks, then run the live check. Why: on 2026-09-24 (codex-cli 0.154.0) a scratch project with a correct DD config ran codex exec with a working model, loaded the dd-* skills, and reported no DD at all, with and without the -c trust override. Trusted project keys in ~/.codex/config.toml are lowercase Windows paths.
not_derivable: Codex's trust gate is not in its documentation; a correct config loading nothing was found live.

evidence.summary: Codex loads project configuration only for trusted projects; each hook needs trust in /hooks.
Codex install steps include trusting the project and hooks.
